reviews.rationale: Only independently inspected exact ecoinvent3.9 cut-off positive-kg inputs are qualified. Reconstruct acetoacetic acid from its actual ethyl-acetate route, not from the unrelated chloroacetic-acid suggestion. Preserve signed caller quantities, supported uncertainty/formulas, independent caller processes and emissions. No molecular-weight, acid-strength, solution, density, yield, water-balance, carbon-balance or allocation multiplier is invented. Other versions, patches, system models and reverse routes receive no new authority. Reuse the exact previously reviewed chemical-heat, electricity, factory and Rest-of-World water mappings and their twelve recipe dependencies unchanged. Their country/grid/fuel/heat-efficiency, upstream supply, allocation, internal-uncertainty and imported biosphere limitations remain. The parent fingerprint binds their full frozen recipe closure. Forty-six literal previously approved production-only allocated cut-off-handover omissions remain audited in those inherited recipes; no new source omission, nonempty waste loss or burden-free treatment is approved. The caller owns separate emissions and any independently listed credit; add no new recovery credit. All retained final freight uses complete native European rail, Rhine barge, lorry fleet and ocean-container services per original tonne-km. Preserve every source entry, quantity and supported uncertainty separately, without normalization or distance/payload/fleet/fuel corrections. Geographic, steam/electric/diesel traction, loading, infrastructure, fleet-age and allocation differences remain explicit whole-service screening limits; final product delivery is additional to native upstream production transport once. Complete native esterification and mass-allocated butane-oxidation ethyl-acetate supplies replace the corresponding source process inventories, per their positive1kg product references. Keep both technologies and all four original regional producer shares in the feedstock market, with its four delivery entries. Native butane supply is already allocated per kg ethyl-acetate co-product: no second mass/economic allocation, avoided co-product credit or recovered-product factor is added. Native ethanol feedstock, raw materials, processing energy, emission/effluent coverage, allocation, geography, vintage and uncertainty differ from source and retain unquantified score effects. Native esterification reference is named ethyl acetate, has formulaC4H8O2 and explicitly consumes ethanol plus acetic acid, but its CAS metadata000123-86-4 differs from source ethyl-acetate CAS141-78-6. Functional selection uses the independently inspected product name, formula, reaction technology, inputs and positive reference, not the conflicting CAS field alone. Preserve the original native metadata and log this identifier inconsistency; do not silently correct it or claim equal purity/grade/LCIA. Do not use methyl acetate, chloroacetic acid or the ester itself as the finished acetoacetic-acid product. Source acetoacetic-acid model is stoichiometric/literature based with estimated releases and standard utility/infrastructure assumptions, not a measured complete plant. Reconstruct both RER and RoW source production vectors rather than replacing acid by a different chemical. Source uncertainties and model omissions remain limitations; a finite LCI does not establish industrial completeness or source/native LCIA equivalence. Existing heat/water helper releases remain their own independent utility inventories. Use complete native European decarbonised water per signedkg once, not drykg, deionised/drinking water or a cooling service. Raw-water origin, hardness, chemical/energy use, degassing/precipitation, residues, water returns, geography/vintage and internal uncertainty differ; no purity, density, salt, loss or balance correction is inferred. Their source3.6 authorities and raw rule fingerprints stay unchanged; only independent3.9 scope is added. No runtime Python or alternative sector engine changes. New native-facing helpers retain all source acetoacetic production inputs, both market producer portfolios and final freight; earlier source graphs and utility recipes remain immutable. All imported/native inventory coverage and methodological approximations remain warnings with unquantified score effects.
